observations: Photo 0 and photo 1 show a bare 4-cylinder engine block with valve cover, alternator, belt pulleys, and various sensors/wiring visible.
A watermark reads 'EMMY GOLD AUTO SPARE' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' - this is the seller's shop branding, not an engine marking.
No engine code, VIN plate, or manufacturer stamp is legible in either photo.
No oil pan, flywheel, or underside of block shown - cannot assess for cracks or leaks.
No start-up, compression test, or running video provided.

claims.evidence: No Hyundai or Kia logo, engine code, or stamp is visible in photo 0 or photo 1; the only visible text is the seller's own watermark.

risks.risk: True make/model of the engine is unconfirmed, which directly changes which comparable applies and the price bracket.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine ID/code stamp (usually on the block near the bellhousing or on a sticker) or a VIN/engine-code plate.
risks.if_unproven: Cannot be priced against any specific comparable; treated as unidentified 4-cylinder unit.

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may have internal damage (seized, cracked block, worn rings).
risks.proof: A video of the engine starting and idling, or a compression test reading.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working / non-runner worst case.

risks.risk: Mileage and prior accident/flood history unknown.
risks.proof: Odometer photo from donor vehicle or import paperwork/mileage sticker.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as high-mileage/unknown history worst case.

risks.risk: Completeness of accessories (turbo, injectors, ECU, wiring harness) not fully visible.
risks.proof: Full 360° photo set including underside, intake, and exhaust manifold sides.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as partial/incomplete assembly worst case.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine code/ID stamp or sticker that identifies make and model.
Video of the engine starting and running (with sound).
Photo of the underside/oil pan area for leak or crack inspection.
Any paperwork, invoice, or donor-vehicle photo showing mileage and origin.
response.reason: The seller's claimed brand and model (Hyundai/Kia) cannot be read from either photo, and since the comparables are priced specifically by engine make/model, no worst-case price can be assigned without a legible engine code or ID shot.
